'''Cedral Gend''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and a member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Gend was an expert and hunter of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexuses]] and [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side artifacts]]. In his research, Gend gained allies in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and even the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]]. He quickly noticed the diffusion of the [[Seeds of Rage]] by the [[Dread Masters]], and tasked a Republic individual with the mission to find and destroy them.<ref name="TOR" />

During the [[Third Galactic War]], he was present at [[Port Nowhere]] when the [[Hidden Chain]] attacked, with Gend being taken hostage by [[Cantis Bralor]].<ref name="Nowhere">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Road to Nowhere|[[Port Nowhere]]}}</ref>  

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
For Republic players, Cedral Gend provides the mission "Buried Evils". At the end of the mission chain, Gend will have different dialogue depending on whether the player had recovered or merged the Seeds of Rage. If the player took the dark side option and merged the Seeds, Gend will note that he could not sense the artifacts' presence. The players can then either say they've been neutralized, or lie that they destroyed the Seeds or handed them over to the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]].<ref name="Buried Evils">{{TORcite|type=general|Exp=rothc|Buried Evils|Coruscant}}</ref>

Cedral Gend was to appear as a boss in the cut Imperial storyline on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]].

If a Republic player is playing either a Jedi Knight or Consular in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith'']] mission "Chains in the Dark," Cedral Gend will appear as Cantis Bralor's hostage. If the player had completed "Uprooting the Last Seed" prior to playing this mission, Gend will thank the player for their help. If not, he will comment that the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] had made the search much harder.<ref name="Nowhere" /> For Sith players, the hostage taken by Cantis is [[Markan]] rather than Cedral Gend.
